method.causal_boundary: Only the AnalysisContext prefix is passed to simulation
method.factual_future_use: Future gaps/positions and actual compounds exist only here
method.policy_cohort: Every reported policy metric uses the same usable snapshots
method.circularity_guard: Simulation never receives Phase 4 score, margin or recommendation; the recommendation is consulted only after outcomes exist to select an action.

global_tyre_age_threshold.method: Rounded median pre-stop age across the complete development split

backmarkers.definition: P16+ on the common held-out cohort

phase4_recalibration.reason: Outcome-model factual errors must be judged before its counterfactual ranking can justify changing Phase 4. Validation races were not used to tune Phase 4.
